data.title: 若叶睦 · 兔子明信片
data.description: 明信片上画着一只兔子。她想了很久要写什么，最后只写下一句问候，再认真签上名字。
data.camera: 俯角中景，明信片与桌面同框
data.promptProse: Seated in a quiet cafe nook, Mutsumi pens a brief message onto a postcard featuring a watercolor illustration of a wild rabbit. A plain ceramic teacup sits on the warm timber table as afternoon sunlight slants through the cafe window.
data.animaCaption: Writing a single thoughtful line beside the rabbit illustration, she pauses to let the dark fountain ink dry on the card.
